g.text: MKH-8020 pair, ORTF. Sound Devices. No mains.
-60 dBFS floor in the stairwell. Very good.
It was powered down when we arrived. No fridge, no lift, no
accidental hum. If anything is singing now, I put it back
into the walls myself; I know which board will shut it up.
Down the west stair to B3 first, because it is the deadest
room in the plan and if I can hold a clean minute there I
can hold one anywhere. Oh who am I kidding?! I just really
The trick is the same trick it always is: stop moving
before you press record, and stay stopped for ten seconds
